policy.scope: Audit existing Bauman Master Hub subject content against the competency gates required to prepare for the official IU5 2026 curriculum.
policy.rule: Existing content may be reused only when its actual lesson/scaffold covers a gate topic. Optional UGV/USV/control content must not be counted toward readiness unless the gate explicitly needs it.
